summary: Waddle Play MVP tested end-to-end. Backend pytest suite: 11/11 passed (auth, playdates, join, families, safety block/unblock, report, profile update). Frontend Expo web preview: sign-in with demo creds, home greeting + trust strip + 5+ playdate cards render, tapping card opens detail, Request to Join transitions to 'Joined ✓', report modal submits, block/report buttons present, Explore chips (6) work, Profile shows Demo Parent + sign out returns to Sign In. All critical flows working.

issues: Deprecated 'shadow*' style props warning in console — should migrate to 'boxShadow' per RN Web recent deprecation.

action_items: Note: review_request stated testIDs signin-*, playdate-card-*, chip-* but actual code uses signin-email-input, signin-password-input, signin-submit-button (still correctly namespaced). All listed testIDs in review (home-greeting, home-trust-strip, playdate-title, playdate-join, playdate-block, playdate-report, family-block, family-report, profile-name, profile-signout, chip-*, playdate-card-*) exist and work — just with '-input'/'-button' suffixes on inputs. No fix required unless naming consistency desired.
Optional: replace shadow* style props with boxShadow to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); consider lifespan context manager for future FastAPI versions.
JWT_SECRET has a dev fallback default; ensure it's set via env for production.
match_score for /families endpoint reuses playdate scoring by faking a pseudo-playdate dict — works but slightly hacky.
seed_data_creation: None created. Used seeded demo user demo@waddleplay.com/password123 and existing 6 families + 5 playdates seeded on backend startup. Test also created transient TEST_* signup users and one report record (harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend BASE_URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Login POST /api/auth/login with demo@waddleplay.com/password123. Playdates ranked by match_score desc. TestIDs use suffixes '-input'/'-button' on inputs and submit buttons in sign-in/sign-up/report screens.
